column1: # glossary.tsv -- JFDiagrammer's binding terms in five languages (FEATURES.md 3.17, LG-06)
# A row: the term's key (German), then the word in de, en, es, it, fr.  The catalogue
# (locales/ui.tsv) and the help use these words; check_lang.py warns when a catalogue row
# that has the German word lacks the word of another language, and fails on the forbidden
# terms below.  Each language has descriptive terms of its own; Visio's own terms
# (SmartShapes, AutoConnect, Quick Shapes, ShapeSheet in the UI) are used in none (F8, F13).
# "Verbindungspfeile" stands for Visio's "AutoVerbinden" until the user decides (PLAN.md,
# forbidden: "!", the language ("*" every language), the term (case-insensitive, a whole word)
